notes.title: Hotfix #1 🔥
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We just addressed some issues you may have encountered and added two new SFX.

[list]
[*] Added shop open SFX.
[*] Added storage purchase SFX.
[*] Fixed issue where the thief sometimes returns to the shop instead of running away.
[*] Fixed issue where the player could pay the drunkman without having enough money.
[*] Fixed purchased upgrades or floor not loading on scene change.
[*] Fixed incorrect level text when loading a save.
[*] Fixed issue allowing empty checkouts to be ordered.
[*] Fixed VSync issue.
[/list]

Have fun and please report any bugs you encounter.
